SmallYeti.desc: While in party, reduces the chance of being detected by enemies. (Does not stack)

Yeti_Grass.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Ground damage and are immune to Muddy status. (Does not stack)

CandleGhost.desc: While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Neutral damage. (Does not stack) Sometimes digs up Bone when assigned to Ranch.

VenusFlytrap.desc: While in party, when the player performs a dodge roll or dodge step, Carnibora creates a whirlwind that deals damage to enemies it touches (Grass / Power: (40~80)). (Does not stack)

KingBahamut.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the Attack and Defense of the Pal fighting alongside you by (5~10)% whenever you defeat an enemy. This effect lasts 20 seconds and stacks up to five times.

KingBahamut_Dragon.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, improves player's and Pals' Dragon damage to enemy weak points by (25~40)%. (Does not stack)

GrassGolem.desc: Can be ridden. When activated, Dualith fires a powerful Grass laser from its right hand.

GrassGolem_Dark.desc: Can be ridden. When activated, Dualith Noct fires a powerful Dark laser from its right hand.

Anubis.desc: When activated, Anubis changes the player's attack type to Ground and increases Attack by (30~50)%. Occasionally evades attacks with a flash sidestep during battle.

Sekhmet.desc: While at base, boosts Anubis's work speed by (20~40)%. Increases efficiency by (30~60)% if Sekhmet is also working at a Workbench, Workshop, or other related facilities. (Does not stack)

ScorpionMan.desc: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Poison by (50~65)%. (Does not stack)

ScorpionMan_Electric.desc: When activated, Prixter Lux changes the player's attack type to Electric and increases Attack by (30~50)%.

CubeTurtle.desc: Can be ridden While at a base, increases the Mining Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

CubeTurtle_Neutral.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the durability of all weapons and armor by (80~100)%. (Does not stack)

BadCatgirl.desc: When activated, Nyafia will fire a shotgun at nearby enemies for a limited time. While in party, increases the player's shotgun damage by (10~35)%. (Does not stack)

MimicDog.desc: While fighting together, Mimog can open treasure chests without using a key.

DarkAlien.desc: While in party, increases the damage of the last bullet fired from a full-auto weapon by (100~160)%. (Does not stack)

WhiteAlienDragon.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the player's energy weapon damage by (10~35)%. (Does not stack)

BlueberryFairy.desc: While at a base, Prunelia's prayers bless the crops, increasing their harvest by (18~35)%.

GhostRabbit.desc: While fighting together, Pals drop +(100~200)% more Pal Souls when defeated. (Does not stack)

GhostRabbit_Grass.desc: While in party, increases Defense of Grass Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack)

BlackPuppy.desc: When activated, uses its sharp sense of smell to detect nearby Chromite. While fighting together, Chromite acquisition increases by +(100~200)%.

BlackPuppy_Ice.desc: While at a base, increases the Cooling Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

MysteryMask.desc: While in party, increases Party Pals' EXP gained by (40~80)%. (Does not stack)

IceNarwhal.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, fishing minigames start with the capture gauge increased by (5~14)%. Additionally, while the bars overlap, capture progress increases by (5~14)%. (Does not stack)

IceNarwhal_Fire.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, fishing minigame begins with the capture gauge (7~17)% higher than usual, and capture progress increases by (7~17)% while the bars overlap. (Does not stack)

GrassRabbitMan.desc: While in party, grants 1 additional jump and 1 additional mid-air dash. (Does not stack)

GrimGirl.desc: While in party, the amount of items obtained from using the Meat Cleaver increases by (100~200)%. (Does not stack)

GoldenHorse.desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Ground and increases Attack by (5~20)%.

SifuDog.desc: When activated, teleports to the nearest base. Cannot be used inside dungeons or similar areas.

SumoDog.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Electric damage and are immune to Electrify. (Does not stack)

WhiteDeer.desc: Can be ridden. This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increases by (2~6)% for each other Neutral Pal in your party. When in party, recovers Health of the player and Party Pals by (0.15~0.75)% per second. (Does not stack)

WhiteDeer_Dark.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, the Pal fighting alongside you gradually loses Health in exchange for (40~80)% Attack increase. (Does not stack)

BlackMetalDragon.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Increases the damage dealt to ores by (1100~3300)%, and you can obtain (150~300)% more Ore while mounted.

WingGolem.desc: When activated, a steel resolve increases Knocklem's Attack by (50~200)% and Defense by (50~200)% for a limited time.

WingGolem_Fire.desc: When activated, a steel resolve increases Knocklem Ignis's Attack by (60~210)% and Defense by (60~210)% for a limited time.

WhiteShieldDragon.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces shield regeneration delay by (30~60)% and reduces damage taken by your shield by (65~80)%. (Does not stack)

BlueThunderHorse.desc: Can be ridden. Grants Air Dash, to move at even higher speeds.

LongCat.desc: While in party, reduces the effects of gravity on the player, making them more floaty while jumping and falling. (Does not stack)

ElecSnail.desc: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Electrify (2~6). (Does not stack)

ElecSnail_Ground.desc: While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Water damage, and are immune to Soak. (Does not stack)

DandelionGirl.desc: While in party, increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with Ivy-Covered. (Does not stack)

BrownRabbit.desc: While in party, increases the player's Defense by (50~65)% while sprinting. (Does not stack)

HoodGhost.desc: While in party, increases the player's damage dealt to enemies that are not in combat by (50~100)%. (Does not stack)

ElecLizard.desc: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Electrify, the enemy discharges electricity, dealing damage equal to (40~60)% of the player's attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.)

OniGhostGirl.desc: While in party, attacking enemies afflicted with Poison reduces their Attack by (40~80)%. (Does not stack)

KingSunfish.desc: Can be ridden to travel on water. While in party, makes it easier to fish up talented Pals. (Does not stack)

KingSunfish_Thunder.desc: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Electric and increases Attack by (5~20)%. While in party, makes it easier to fish up talented Pals. (Does not stack)

SleeveRabbit.desc: While in party, reduces the Partner Skill cooldowns for other party Pals by (10~50)%. (Does not stack)

GhostDragon.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increase by (2~6)% for each other Dragonor Dark Pal in your party.

GhostDragon_Fire.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increase by (2~6)% or each other Dragon or Fire Pal in your party. (Excluding Eidrolon Ignis)

ThunderFluffyBird.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While at a base, shortens the time it takes to incubate eggs by (20~40)%. (Does not stack)

RedFlowerBird.desc: While in party, extends the invincibility period during dodge rolls and dodge steps by (15~30)%. (Does not stack)

FoxExorcist.desc: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Burn, the enemy explodes, dealing damage equal to (40~60)% of the player's attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.)

LotusDragon.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, the player's attacks inflict Soak (2~6). (Does not stack)

ClownRabbit.desc: While in party, when the player's Health falls below 50%, Dupin generates an explosion around the player (Fire / Power: (100~200) / Burn buildup: 777). Additionally, while the player's Health is below 50%, the player's Attack is increased by (30~50)%. (Does not stack)

ThiefBird.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Blind by (50~65)%. (Does not stack)

SnakeGirl.desc: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Blind (2~6). (Does not stack)

MushroomLady.desc: While at a base, increases the Medicine Production Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

LanternButler.desc: While in party, the player's arrows explode on contact, dealing additional damage equal to (15~30)% of the player's attack damage. (Does not stack)

MoonChild.desc: While in party, increases Defense of Dark Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack)

MonochromeQueen.desc: While in party, increases the player's Attack by (30~80)% if all Pals in party are different species. (Does not stack)

KabukiMan.desc: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Burn (2~6). (Does not stack)

DomeArmorDragon.desc: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take (60~80)% less damage from explosive attacks, and are immune to Stun. (Does not stack)

ElecPanda.desc: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a minigun while mounted.

LilyQueen.desc: When activated, the queen's soothing graces restore the Health of the player and Party Pals by (80~90)%.

LilyQueen_Dark.desc: When activated, the queen's soothing graces restore the Health of the player and Party Pals by (85~95)%.

ThunderDragonMan.desc: While in party, hitting an enemy with a bullet increases the Attack and Defense of the Pal fighting alongside you by (1~5)% for 5 seconds. This effect stacks up to 30 times. (Does not stack.)

Horus.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, Ice Pals drop (40~80)% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

Horus_Water.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, Fire Pals drop (40~80)% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

BlackGriffon.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased. Enhances Dark attacks by (15~30)% while mounted.

MoonQueen.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, enhances Neutral and Dark attacks by (15~30)%.

SnowTigerBeastman.desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, delivers crushing blows with a hammer forged from Ice.

BlueSkyDragon.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Attack increases by (4~8)% for each other Dragon Pal in your party.

Mothman.desc: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Ivy-Covered, the enemy explodes, dealing additional damage equal to (40~60)% of the player's attack damage. (Does not stack) Also grants immunity to the World Tree's Explosive Spores to both the player and their Pals.

FlowerPrince.desc: When activated, the player's attacks inflict Poison (2~6). While in party, grants the player and party Pals immunity to Poison, and nullifies the effects of toxic gas in the World Tree area. (Does not stack)

NightLady.desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Nightmare Ray. When this Pal uses Nightmare Ray, it has a x(1.1~2.5) damage multiplier.

NightLady_Dark.desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Nightmare Bloom. When this Pal uses Nightmare Bloom, it has a x(1.1~2.5) damage multiplier.

DarkMechaDragon.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, damage done by Partner Skills of weapon-wielding Pals increases by (20~50)%. (Does not stack)

LegendDeer.desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, it generates a barrier that blocks all attacks. Can triple jump while mounted.

SaintCentaur.desc: Can be ridden. Can triple jump while mounted. Activate Spear Thrust to have Necromus stay by your side and attack enemies in tandem.

BlackCentaur.desc: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. When Twin Spears skill is activated, a Paladius in your party will appear and attack alongside you.

IceHorse.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Ice, inflict Freeze (2~6), increases Attack by (10~40)%.

IceHorse_Dark.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Dark, inflict Blind (2~6), increases Attack by (10~40)%.

PoseidonOrca.desc: While in party, it follows up the player's attacks with Water spear strikes. Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, it can leap high into the air over water.

JetDragon.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.

KingWhale.desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Only 1 can be summoned to a base. While at a base, it constantly patrols the skies and bombards intruders from high above.

YakushimaMonster001_Blue.desc: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.

YakushimaMonster003.desc: While in party, appears near the player. Automatically picks up nearby items.

YakushimaBoss001_Small.desc: While in party, increases Attack of Dark Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack)

YakushimaMonster002.desc: While in party, Dark Pals drop (40~80)% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

YakushimaBoss001.desc: When activated, Eye of Cthulhu charges and attacks targeted enemy.

YakushimaMonster001.desc: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.

YakushimaMonster003_Purple.desc: While in party, appears near the player. Automatically picks up nearby items.

YakushimaMonster001_Pink.desc: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.

YakushimaMonster001_Purple.desc: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.

YakushimaMonster001_Rainbow.desc: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.

YakushimaMonster001_Red.desc: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.
